result.title: Same Answer, Different Reasons: Trace-Level Divergence in Multilingual Large Language Models
result.summary: Multilingual large language models are increasingly deployed in settings where visible reasoning traces support verification, education, and safety auditing, yet standard evaluations typically measure only final-answer agreement or holistic response similarity. As a result, they establish outcome consistency without determining whether users across languages receive comparable supporting evidence. We introduce a trace-level divergence framework that compares visible reasoning traces as structured sequences, decomposing agreement into structural similarity, order consistency, and holistic similarity, with pair-specific calibration to enable comparison across languages. Across three reasoning benchmarks, seven languages, and six frontier LLMs, the natural baseline---embedding each whole response and comparing the two by cosine---systematically overstates agreement: $52.1\%$--$67.3\%$ of examples in the top quartile of holistic similarity are not in the top quartile of structural similarity. This dissociation is stable across sentence encoders and step segmentations, and blind bilingual annotation studies in two English-anchored language pairs show that human judgments align with structural similarity rather than with the holistic baseline. A same-language control shows that the level of divergence is language-specific: two English traces for paraphrases of the same question agree more closely than an English trace and its counterparts in other languages. Our results show that answer-level and holistic evaluations can substantially overestimate the consistency of multilingual explanatory artifacts, motivating trace-level evaluation for reliable multilingual deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 trace-level divergence 框架，将可见推理链作为结构化序列比较，分解为结构相似度、顺序一致性与整体相似度并做配对校准，在三个推理基准、七种语言、六个前沿 LLM 上表明整体嵌入相似度会系统性高估一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「整体相似度掩盖步骤级结构差异」的分解与校准思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent/视觉推理轨迹的比较方式，提示仅用整体表示相似度评价推理一致性的风险；但对象为纯文本多语言轨迹，需较多迁移核查。
